novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits the closer Xia--Yan--Wainwright preprint, Inference under Staggered Adoption: Case Study of the Affordable Care Act (arXiv:2412.09482), which studies low-rank staircase panels and treated-cell inference, even though it does not supply the proposed event-curve band.

novelty_flags.label: Proposition prop:two-horizon-shared-cell-witness
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposition refutes an unnamed “cohort-horizon blocks as independent” covariance calculation but identifies no published estimator, bootstrap, or workflow that makes that calculation.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem thm:staircase-covariance
soundness_flags.one_line: A nonzero individual shared-cell product does not imply nonzero total off-diagonal covariance: distinct shared-cell coefficient products can cancel, so the claimed “whenever such a shared product is nonzero” consequence is algebraically false.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question oeq:attainable-remainder-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: “Every strictly weaker proposed envelope” has no defined ordering, and the fixed-eta quantile DeltaStar(K;eta) is not by itself a specified necessity criterion for uniform coverage; quantify over eta_n or define a tail/modulus order and the coverage experiment.
